# Netflix Canada
> Stream Netflix movies, TV shows, and related video content across web, mobile, TV, and connected devices.

Netflix Canada provides subscription streaming access to films, series, documentaries, kids content, and account management resources, along with support, media information, and legal documentation.

## Watch and Browse
- [Browse](https://www.nflxvideo.net/browse): Browse available Netflix titles by profile and personalized recommendations.
- [Latest](https://www.nflxvideo.net/latest): View recently added movies and TV shows on Netflix.
- [Kids](https://www.nflxvideo.net/Kids): Access the Netflix kids experience with family-friendly programming.
- [Title Search](https://www.nflxvideo.net/search): Search the Netflix catalog for movies, series, genres, and people.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.nflxvideo.net/gift-cards): Learn about Netflix gift cards and redemption options.

## Account and Membership
- [Your Account](https://www.nflxvideo.net/YourAccount): Manage membership, billing, profiles, and playback settings.
- [Login](https://www.nflxvideo.net/login): Sign in to access your Netflix account and streaming features.
- [Signup](https://www.nflxvideo.net/signup): Start a Netflix membership and choose a subscription plan.
- [Redeem](https://www.nflxvideo.net/redeem): Redeem a Netflix gift card or promotional code.
- [Manage Profiles](https://www.nflxvideo.net/ManageProfiles): Create and edit viewing profiles for household members.

## Devices and Apps
- [Watch on TV](https://www.nflxvideo.net/watch-tv): Learn how to watch Netflix on smart TVs and streaming devices.
- [Netflix for iPhone](https://www.nflxvideo.net/iphone): Get information about using Netflix on iPhone devices.
- [Netflix for iPad](https://www.nflxvideo.net/ipad): Get information about using Netflix on iPad devices.
- [Netflix for Android](https://www.nflxvideo.net/android): Learn about the Netflix app experience on Android devices.
- [Netflix for Windows](https://www.nflxvideo.net/windows): Access Netflix viewing options for Windows computers and tablets.
- [Netflix for Game Consoles](https://www.nflxvideo.net/game-consoles): Learn how to stream Netflix on supported gaming systems.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en): Find support articles for billing, streaming, and account issues.
- [How to Sign Up for Netflix](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/412): Learn the steps required to create a Netflix account.
- [Plans and Pricing](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/24926): Review Netflix plan options and membership pricing details.
- [How to Change or Reset Your Password](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/365): Get instructions for password reset and account recovery.
- [Netflix Isn’t Working](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/11634): Troubleshoot common playback, app, and connectivity problems.
- [How to Cancel Netflix](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/407): Follow the process to cancel a Netflix membership.

## Supported Devices
- [Supported Devices](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/14361): Review the categories of devices that can stream Netflix.
- [Using Netflix on Your Smart TV](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/306): Set up and use Netflix on compatible smart TVs.
- [Using Netflix on iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/116080): Learn setup and playback details for Apple mobile devices.
- [Using Netflix on Android Phones or Tablets](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/57688): Get Android app setup, download, and troubleshooting guidance.
- [Using Netflix on Windows Computers or Tablets](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/23931): Learn how to watch Netflix on Windows devices.
- [Using Netflix on PlayStation](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/23888): Find setup instructions for supported PlayStation consoles.

## Billing and Payments
- [Billing and Payments](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/22): Browse help topics related to charges, invoices, and payment methods.
- [How Billing Works on Netflix](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/116380): Understand billing cycles, charges, and renewal timing.
- [Update Payment Information](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/116380): Learn how to change your Netflix payment method.
- [Gift Card and Promotional Code Problems](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/32950): Resolve issues redeeming gift cards and promo codes.
- [Print Your Netflix Invoice](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/15598): Access and print invoices for Netflix charges.

## Privacy and Legal
- [Privacy](https://www.nflxvideo.net/privacy): Review Netflix privacy practices and data handling policies.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.nflxvideo.net/termsofuse): Read the terms governing Netflix service usage.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.nflxvideo.net/cookiepreferences): Manage cookie settings and consent preferences.
- [Corporate Information](https://www.nflxvideo.net/corporateinformation): View company and corporate contact information.
- [Legal Notices](https://www.nflxvideo.net/legalnotices): Access legal notices and intellectual property information.

## Media and Company
- [Media Center](https://media.nflxvideo.net/): Explore Netflix press releases, company news, and media resources.
- [Newsroom](https://media.nflxvideo.net/en/): Read official Netflix announcements and press materials.
- [Top 10](https://top10.nflxvideo.net/): View weekly top-performing Netflix films and series by region.
- [Jobs](https://jobs.nflxvideo.net/): Explore Netflix careers, teams, and open roles.
- [Investor Relations](https://ir.nflxvideo.net/): Access financial reports, earnings, and investor information.

## Accessibility and Contact
- [Accessibility](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/100639): Learn about accessibility features and supported viewing options.
- [Contact Us](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/contactus): Reach Netflix customer service for account and streaming support.
- [Audio Description](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/25079): Find titles and devices that support audio description.
- [Subtitles and Captioning](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/100267): Learn how to use subtitles, captions, and alternate audio.
- [Parental Controls](https://help.nflxvideo.net/en/node/264): Set maturity levels, profile locks, and viewing restrictions.
